issue.title: M4a Auth Workspace Bootstrap fixture uses invalid UUID
issue.original_error: psycopg.errors.InvalidTextRepresentation: invalid input syntax for type uuid: "f2000000-0000-0000-0000-wsboot001111"

root_cause_matrix.Fixture: YES: _NO_WS_USER_ID was a non-UUID string used as %s::uuid
root_cause_matrix.Seed: NO: seed logic was not the source; fixture insert failed before test body
root_cause_matrix.DB_State: NO: database rejected invalid UUID before persistent state could matter
root_cause_matrix.Auth_Guard: NO: auth guard was not reached
root_cause_matrix.Marker_Fehler: SECONDARY: test_preflight.py lacked classification and blocked initial marker collection; fixed as m3a_truth
root_cause_matrix.Testdefekt: YES: test fixture data was invalid for the real PostgreSQL schema

issue.fix: Use tests.postgres_truth.support._uuid_with_prefix("f2000000", "workspace-bootstrap", "no-workspace-user") for _NO_WS_USER_ID and classify test_preflight.py as m3a_truth.
